CommunityApplications.Profile:
Docker app templates maintained by Gill-Bates for Unraid Community Apps.
This repository provides ready-to-use templates for the following Docker containers:
- **fritzinfluxdb** — Pushes Fritz!Box router call and connection data to InfluxDB for Grafana visualisation. - **Velociraptor** — DFIR (Digital Forensics & Incident Response) server with auto-generated config, multi-arch client repacks and a full web GUI. - **UniFi OS Server** — Full UniFi OS stack (Network Application, Identity Hub, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, nginx) running as a single Docker container with systemd.
For support, bug reports, or template requests please open an issue on GitHub.
